title: What Scripture Actually Says About Anxiety (It's Not “Just Pray Harder”)
caption:
Anxiety isn't proof your faith is weak. Philippians 4 doesn't scold you. It hands you a way to move the weight.

Name it, thank Him, and do the next small thing. If it stays heavy for weeks, tell a brother and see a doctor. That's wisdom.

Save this for the night your mind won't stop.

#faith #scripture #anxiety #godlyman
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
